item.description: Donald Trump spent his Saturday posting fake pictures of himself again. Between attacking his own prosecutor and declaring victory in Iran, he made time to publish 43 posts in an afternoon. In one he kisses a golden Jesus. In another he looms over Greenland, a day after telling a radio host to bet that America will control it before he leaves office. The fakes are his claims that he is holy, that he is young, that the world is his to take. Also today, California became the first place in America where AI content must include data showing where it came from. One state now requires fabrications to identify themselves.
